skills.name: Epic Biker Gang!
skills.desc: ATK SPD of all Goblin Bikers on my field increases by 40% for each Goblin Biker summoned on my field.

skills.name: Random Dice
skills.desc: Roll a die once every 90 sec. Based on the roll result, gain Gold in proportion to the current Gold amount.

upgraded.desc: Roll a die once every 45 sec. Based on the roll result, gain Gold in proportion to the current Gold amount.

skills.name: Incendiary Shell
skills.desc: Enemies hit by basic attacks receive a 50% Healing Reduction. The required attack count for Piercing Round is reduced by 2. (Does not stack)

upgraded.desc: Enemies hit by basic attacks receive a 75% Healing Reduction. The required attack count for Piercing Round is reduced by 3. (Does not stack)

skills.name: Quantum Bomb
skills.desc: For every 50 Piercing Rounds fired, launches a Quantum Bomb at the target location. The Quantum Bomb deals 2500% ATK to enemies within 2 tiles, 10 times.

upgraded.desc: For every 35 Piercing Rounds fired, launches a Quantum Bomb at the target location. The Quantum Bomb deals 5000% ATK to enemies within 2 tiles, 10 times.

skills.name: My Little Asura
skills.desc: Little Asuras appear instead of Asura Parts for the next 15 Asura Part spawns. Little Asuras can be merged with Asura and are treated as having 1 of every Asura Part.

upgraded.desc: Little Asuras appear instead of Asura Parts for the next 10 Asura Part spawns. Little Asuras can be merged with Asura and are treated as having 3 of every Asura Part.

skills.name: Seal Released
skills.desc: Hit Count increases by 1 for every 30 Parts merged into Asura. (Max 4)

upgraded.desc: Hit Count increases by 1 for every 15 Parts merged into Asura. (Max 8)

skills.name: Lord's Authority
skills.desc: Allows the Shadow Lord to be freely summoned or recalled. Gain 2x Souls when absorbing Souls.

upgraded.desc: Allows the Shadow Lord to be freely summoned or recalled. Gain 3x Souls when absorbing Souls.

skills.name: Devouring Darkness
skills.desc: Creates a zone that engulfs enemies based on Range. Enemies entering take Fixed DMG equal to 10% of Base ATK per Soul. Absorbs 1 Soul for each enemy defeated within the zone.

upgraded.desc: Creates a zone that engulfs enemies based on Range. Enemies entering take Fixed DMG equal to 30% of Base ATK per Soul. Absorbs 2 Soul for each enemy defeated within the zone.

skills.name: Wind Turbine
skills.desc: All Monsters on the field have a 10% chance to attack once more on basic attacks. While affected by Airborne, removes the effect with 50% chance, and increases the effect of Wind Turbine by 2x for 10s.

upgraded.desc: All Monsters on the field have a 15% chance to attack once more on basic attacks. While affected by Airborne, removes the effect with 100% chance, and increases the effect of Wind Turbine by 2x for 10s.

skills.name: Missile Barrage
skills.desc: Instead of Basic Attacks, fires 6 missiles at random enemies within range every 1s. Each missile deals Fixed DMG equal to 1% of the total damage dealt by all monsters on the field over the past 1s.

upgraded.desc: Instead of Basic Attacks, fires 10 missiles at random enemies within range every 1s. Each missile deals Fixed DMG equal to 1.2% of the total damage dealt by all monsters on the field over the past 1s.

skills.name: Unstoppable Force
skills.desc: Multiplies the ATK Boost Effect by 2x. When Exhaustion ends, transforms back into the Awakened state.

upgraded.desc: Multiplies the ATK Boost Effect by 3x. When Exhaustion ends, transforms back into the Awakened state.

skills.name: Spotlight
skills.desc: While Awakened, shines a spotlight on the surrounding 1 tiles. Allies within range gain +1 Range and become immune to Darkness effects. Additionally, each time this unit is affected by a spotlight, gains a random 0 ~ 100 stacks. Each stack increases CRIT DMG by 0.3%.

upgraded.desc: While Awakened, shines a spotlight on the surrounding 1 tiles. Allies within range gain +1 Range and become immune to Darkness effects. Additionally, each time this unit is affected by a spotlight, gains a random 0 ~ 100 stacks. Each stack increases CRIT DMG by 0.7%.

skills.name: Voodoo of Fair Winds
skills.desc: Grants all Monsters on the field +0.5 Base ATK SPD. Monsters that have reached MAX ATK SPD additionally gain +10% Basic Attack DMG.

upgraded.desc: Grants all Monsters on the field +1 Base ATK SPD. Monsters that have reached MAX ATK SPD additionally gain +20% Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Voodoo of Stormcall
skills.desc: Casts a gale on the selected tile every 20s, creating a storm with 0.5 Range. Allies hit by the storm are lifted into the air for 5s and gain +15% Final DMG for 15s.

upgraded.desc: Casts a gale on the selected tile every 20s, creating a storm with 1.5 Range. Allies hit by the storm are lifted into the air for 3s and gain +30% Final DMG for 15s.

skills.name: Disciple
skills.desc: Form a bond with one selected Supreme Demon God. Master Cat's ATK increases by 20% for each enemy defeated by the disciple, and by 1% for each kill assist. (Stacks up to 1000%)

upgraded.desc: Form a bond with one selected Supreme Demon God. Master Cat's ATK increases by 50% for each enemy defeated by the disciple, and by 2% for each kill assist. (Stacks up to 2000%)

skills.name: Mark of the Hunt

upgraded.desc: Applies a Mark of the Hunt to enemies damaged by Mind's Eye. When another ally damages a marked enemy, has a 50% chance to trigger Mind's Eye on that enemy. (Max 10)

skills.name: I Love Your Money Too

upgraded.desc: ATK gained from Moneygrubber increases by 100% for each Goblin Biker summoned on my field.

skills.name: I Love Money

upgraded.desc: For every 100000 Gold, Coin Man's attack target increases by 1 (Max 7). If there aren't enough enemies, Coin Man will attack its targets additional times.

upgraded.desc: Summons a baby Blue Dragon that patrols back and forth from the enemy spawn to the Demon Castle. Enemies near the baby dragon take 250% increased damage.

upgraded.desc: Every 10s, strikes 10 random enemies with lightning, reducing their shield by 50% (Excludes special targets).

upgraded.desc: On hit, has a 40% chance to freeze the target for 1s.

baseSkills.desc: At the start of each wave, has a 3% chance to hatch, and this chance increases by 3% with every wave. When hatched, moves to one of the top 3 highest-level Supreme Demon Gods on either field. (Remains on standby if no Supreme Demon God is available)

baseSkills.name: Flip's Blessing
baseSkills.desc: When dealing damage, has a 3(+0.2)% chance to deal additional damage equal to 4(+0.2)% of the enemy's Max Shield.

baseSkills.name: Luna's Blessing
baseSkills.desc: When dealing damage, has a 1(+0.2)% chance to gain 10 Gold and 4 Magic Stones.

baseSkills.name: Mir's Blessing
baseSkills.desc: Increase Supreme Demon God's level by 1.

skills.name: Weapon Mod
skills.desc: Deploy Mode: Grants 200% ATK and CRIT DMG to all Claras on the player's field. (This effect stacks) — Focus Mode: Each hit increases Clara's ATK and CRIT DMG by 5% (Max 10000%). Resets when no targets are available.

upgraded.desc: Deploy Mode: Grants 300% ATK and CRIT DMG to all Claras on the player's field. (This effect stacks) — Focus Mode: Each hit increases Clara's ATK and CRIT DMG by 50% (Max 100000%). Resets when no targets are available.

skills.name: Bomb Mod
skills.desc: Deploy Mode: Each time the Time Bomb explodes, it is replanted with 70% of its current stacks retained. After 30 explosions, blast radius +1 and each explosion deals damage 2 times. — Focus Mode: Aims at and focuses an enemy instead of planting a Time Bomb. After 10s, snipes for Fixed DMG equal to 50% of all Basic Attack DMG dealt to the target by all Claras while aiming. Increases sniper shots against that target by 1 (Can stack). On kill, excess damage is transferred to a random enemy.

upgraded.desc: Deploy Mode: Each time the Time Bomb explodes, it is replanted with 90% of its current stacks retained. After 20 explosions, blast radius +1 and each explosion deals damage 3 times. — Focus Mode: Aims at and focuses an enemy instead of planting a Time Bomb. After 7s, snipes for Fixed DMG equal to 150% of all Basic Attack DMG dealt to the target by all Claras while aiming. Increases sniper shots against that target by 1 (Can stack). On kill, excess damage is transferred to a random enemy.

skills.name: Dokkaebi Dance
skills.desc: Deals +50% DMG to Air-type enemies. Oni Hunt chance increases by 35%, but Final Blow damage is reduced by 65%.

upgraded.desc: Deals +100% DMG to Air-type enemies. Oni Hunt chance increases by 65%, but Final Blow damage is reduced by 65%.

skills.name: Moon Sword
skills.desc: On Final Blow, has a 25% chance to trigger again (Max 3). At max chain, deals 5000% ATK and 1.5% of enemies' Max Shield to all enemies 7 times. When using Moon Sword, Dokkaebi Dance's bonus damage to airborne enemies is doubled.

upgraded.desc: On Final Blow, has a 50% chance to trigger again (Max 5). At max chain, deals 10000% ATK and 2% of enemies' Max Shield to all enemies 10 times. When using Moon Sword, Dokkaebi Dance's bonus damage to airborne enemies is doubled.
